clientTags.forEach((tagKey,tagValue)->{if (tagKey.length()>MAX_RACK_AWARE_ASSIGNMENT_TAG_KEY_LENGTH){throw new ConfigException(CLIENT_TAG_PREFIX,tagKey,"Tag key exceeds maximum length of "+MAX_RACK_AWARE_ASSIGNMENT_TAG_KEY_LENGTH+".");}if (tagValue.length()>MAX_RACK_AWARE_ASSIGNMENT_TAG_VALUE_LENGTH){throw new ConfigException(CLIENT_TAG_PREFIX,tagValue,"Tag value exceeds maximum length of "+MAX_RACK_AWARE_ASSIGNMENT_TAG_VALUE_LENGTH+".");}})
